lessons.title: Describing trends
lessons.goal_uz: Grafikdagi o'zgarishlarni aniq fe'l, ot va ravishlar bilan tasvirlaysiz — Task 1 uchun asosiy lug'at.

words.ex: Sales rose steadily over the decade.
There was a sharp decline in tourism.
Prices fluctuated between $20 and $30.
The figure remained stable at 40%.
Usage peaked at 80% in 2015.
Car ownership increased dramatically.
The population grew gradually.
Unemployment fell slightly in May.

steps.title: Model answer: cinema attendance
steps.text: The line graph illustrates the number of cinema visits per person in the UK between 1990 and 2020. Overall, attendance rose for most of the period before dropping sharply at the end. In 1990, the average person went to the cinema twice a year. This figure increased gradually over the next two decades and peaked at just over four visits in 2010. It then remained stable until 2018. However, there was a dramatic fall in 2020, when attendance plunged to fewer than one visit per person, the lowest point in the period.
steps.uz: Chiziqli grafik 1990–2020 yillarda Buyuk Britaniyada bir kishiga to'g'ri keladigan kinoga borishlar sonini ko'rsatadi. Umuman olganda, davrning ko'p qismida tashrif oshib bordi, so'ng oxirida keskin tushib ketdi. 1990-yilda o'rtacha odam yiliga ikki marta kinoga borgan. Bu ko'rsatkich keyingi yigirma yil davomida asta-sekin oshib, 2010-yilda to'rtdan biroz ko'proq tashrif bilan cho'qqiga chiqdi. Keyin u 2018-yilgacha barqaror qoldi. Biroq 2020-yilda keskin pasayish bo'ldi — tashrif bir kishiga birdan kam darajaga qulab, davrning eng past nuqtasiga tushdi.

steps.body_uz: Task 1 da **Overview** (umumiy xulosa) bo'lmasa, Task Achievement 5 dan oshmaydi! Overview'ni **Overall, ...** bilan boshlang va faqat eng asosiy tendensiyani yozing — raqamlarsiz. Raqamlar keyingi abzatslarda keladi.

steps.q: Which sentence in the model is the overview?
options: In 1990, the average person went to the cinema twice a year.
Overall, attendance rose for most of the period before dropping sharply at the end.
steps.explain_uz: Overview — umumiy tendensiya, **Overall** bilan boshlangan, raqamsiz.

steps.q: When did attendance reach its highest point?
steps.explain_uz: "peaked at just over four visits in 2010".

steps.title_uz: Ikki xil tuzilma: fe'l + ravish va sifat + ot
steps.body_uz:
Bir xil ma'noni ikki yo'l bilan yozib, lug'atingizni boyiting (Lexical Resource uchun muhim):
**1) Ot + fe'l + ravish:** Sales **increased sharply**.
**2) There was a/an + sifat + ot + in:** There was **a sharp increase in** sales.
Ravish → sifat: sharp**ly** → sharp · gradual**ly** → gradual · slight**ly** → slight · dramatic**ally** → dramatic · steadi**ly** → steady.
Raqamlar bilan predloglar: rose **to** 50% (yetib bordi) · rose **by** 10% (farq) · peaked **at** 80% · **from** 20% **to** 35%.

examples.en: The price of oil fell dramatically in 2008.
There was a dramatic fall in the price of oil.

examples.uz: Eksport 15% ga oshib, 2 mlrd dollarga yetdi.

steps.example: The data shows the number of bike rentals in Tashkent between 2018 and 2022. Overall, rentals rose significantly over the period, despite a slight dip in 2020. After falling slightly to 4,800 in 2020, rentals increased dramatically to 12,000 in 2021 and continued to grow, reaching a peak of 15,000 in 2022.

lessons.title: Linking ideas in essays
lessons.goal_uz: However, moreover, therefore, whereas, despite kabi bog'lovchilarni to'g'ri tuzilma va tinish belgisi bilan ishlatasiz.

words.ex: Moreover, public transport reduces pollution.
However, this solution is expensive.
Therefore, governments should invest more.
Some prefer cities, whereas others like villages.
Despite the rain, the match continued.
For instance, Finland has free education.
As a result, crime rates fell.
On the other hand, online courses lack interaction.

steps.title: Body paragraph: working from home
steps.text: Working from home offers clear benefits for employees. Firstly, it removes the daily commute, which can take up to two hours in large cities. As a result, workers have more time for their families and hobbies. Moreover, many people report that they concentrate better without office distractions. For instance, a 2022 survey found that 60% of remote workers felt more productive. However, these advantages are not universal. Some employees feel isolated, whereas others struggle to separate work from home life. Therefore, a hybrid model may be the most sensible solution.
steps.uz: Uydan ishlash xodimlar uchun aniq foyda beradi. Birinchidan, katta shaharlarda ikki soatgacha vaqt oladigan kundalik yo'l yo'qoladi. Natijada xodimlarda oila va qiziqishlar uchun ko'proq vaqt bo'ladi. Bundan tashqari, ko'pchilik ofisdagi chalg'ituvchi narsalarsiz yaxshiroq diqqat qilishini aytadi. Masalan, 2022-yilgi so'rovnomada masofaviy ishchilarning 60% o'zlarini samaraliroq his qilgan. Biroq bu afzalliklar hamma uchun emas. Ba'zi xodimlar o'zini yolg'iz his qiladi, boshqalari esa ishni uy hayotidan ajratishda qiynaladi. Shu sababli gibrid model eng oqilona yechim bo'lishi mumkin.

steps.q: What is the function of "For instance" in the paragraph?
options: It introduces an example that supports the idea.

steps.q: Which linker introduces the writer's conclusion?

steps.body_uz:
Coherence & Cohesion bahosi aynan shularga bog'liq. Faqat ko'p ishlatish emas — **to'g'ri** ishlatish muhim.
**Gap boshida + vergul:** However, ... · Moreover, ... · Therefore, ... · As a result, ... · For instance, ...
**Ikki qismni bitta gapda bog'laydi:** ..., **whereas** ... · **Although** + gap (ega + fe'l).
**despite / in spite of + ot yoki -ing** (gap emas!): Despite **the rain** ✔ · Despite **being tired** ✔ · Despite **it was raining** ✘ → Despite **the fact that** it was raining ✔.
Ko'p uchraydigan xato: "Although..., but..." — ikkalasini birga ishlatmang!

steps.prompt_uz: IELTS Task 2 uchun bitta asosiy abzats yozing (6–8 gap): "Some people think university education should be free for everyone. Do you agree?" Kamida 4 xil bog'lovchi ishlating.
steps.prompt: Write one body paragraph: Some people think university education should be free for everyone. Do you agree? Use at least four different linkers.
steps.example: There are strong reasons why university education should be free. Firstly, it gives talented students from poor families the same opportunities as wealthy students. As a result, society benefits from a wider pool of skilled professionals. Moreover, graduates without debt can start businesses or families earlier. For instance, Germany abolished tuition fees in 2014, and student numbers have since grown. However, free education requires high taxes, whereas the money could be spent on schools or hospitals. Therefore, governments need to balance access with cost.

lessons.title: Telling a story in Speaking Part 2
lessons.goal_uz: 2 daqiqa davomida voqeani mantiqiy, Past Continuous va Past Perfect bilan boy qilib gapirasiz.

words.ex: I vividly remember my first day at school.
It turned out that the shop was closed.
All of a sudden, the lights went out.
Looking back, it was the right decision.
I had to make a decision quickly.
I was thrilled when I got the results.
My uncle visited us unexpectedly.
That trip was a turning point in my life.

steps.body_uz: Kartochkada 4 ta savol bo'ladi (what / when / where / why). 1 daqiqalik tayyorgarlikda har biriga 2–3 kalit so'z yozing. Gapirish rejasi: **1) Kirish** (What I'd like to talk about is...) → **2) Fon** (When/Where — Past Continuous) → **3) Asosiy voqea** (Past Simple + All of a sudden...) → **4) Natija va his-tuyg'u** (Looking back... / Why). Shu reja 2 daqiqani to'ldiradi va Fluency & Coherence'ni oshiradi.

steps.title: Describe a time you helped someone
steps.text: What I'd like to talk about is a time I helped a tourist in Bukhara about two years ago. I was walking home from university one evening, and it was getting dark. All of a sudden, I noticed an elderly woman who was standing near the Lyabi-Hauz looking at a map, clearly confused. I asked her if she needed help, and it turned out that she had lost her group and her phone had died. Since I had studied English for several years, I was able to explain the situation to a taxi driver and we found her hotel together. She was so grateful that she sent me a postcard from Germany a month later. Looking back, it was a small thing, but it was a turning point for me, because I realised how useful my English could be.
steps.uz: Men taxminan ikki yil oldin Buxoroda bir sayyohga yordam berganim haqida gapirmoqchiman. Bir kuni kechqurun universitetdan uyga ketayotgan edim, qorong'i tushayotgandi. Birdaniga Labi Hovuz yonida xaritaga qarab turgan, sarosimada bo'lgan keksa ayolni ko'rib qoldim. Yordam kerakmi deb so'radim va ma'lum bo'lishicha, u guruhini yo'qotib qo'ygan, telefoni ham o'chib qolgan ekan. Bir necha yil ingliz tili o'rganganim uchun vaziyatni taksi haydovchisiga tushuntira oldim va birga mehmonxonasini topdik. U shunchalik minnatdor bo'ldiki, bir oydan keyin Germaniyadan menga otkritka yubordi. Orqaga nazar tashlasam, bu kichik ish edi, lekin men uchun burilish nuqtasi bo'ldi, chunki ingliz tilim qanchalik foydali ekanini angladim.

steps.explain_uz: "her phone had died" — telefoni o'chib qolgan edi.

options: It changed how he saw his English.
steps.explain_uz: "I realised how useful my English could be".

steps.title_uz: Hikoya zamonlari: Past Simple · Past Continuous · Past Perfect
steps.body_uz:
Uchta zamonni aralashtirish — Grammatical Range uchun eng oson "ball oluvchi" usul.
**Past Continuous (was/were + -ing)** — fon, davom etayotgan jarayon: I **was walking** home, it **was getting** dark.
**Past Simple** — asosiy voqealar ketma-ketligi: I **noticed** a woman, I **asked** her...
**Past Perfect (had + V3)** — hikoyadagi vaqtdan ham **oldinroq** bo'lgan ish: she **had lost** her group (men ko'rishdan oldin).
Tuzilma: I **was walking** home **when** I **noticed** her. (uzun fon + qisqa voqea)

examples.en: I was cooking dinner when the phone rang.
examples.uz: Kechki ovqat pishirayotgan edim, telefon jiringladi.

examples.en: When we arrived, the film had already started.
examples.uz: Biz yetib kelganimizda film allaqachon boshlangan edi.

examples.en: I realised I had left my passport at home.

steps.q: I ___ along the street when I saw an old friend.
steps.explain_uz: Fon jarayoni (… when + qisqa voqea) → **was walking**.

steps.q: When I got to the station, the train ___.
steps.explain_uz: Men kelishimdan **oldin** ketgan → Past Perfect: **had already left**.

steps.text: While I ___ (sleep), someone knocked on the door.
answer: was sleeping

steps.text: It turned out that he ___ forgotten his keys.
answer: had

steps.prompt_uz: Part 2 kartochkasi: "Describe a time when something unexpected happened." Javobingizni 8–10 gapda yozing: Past Continuous, Past Perfect va kamida 2 ta yangi iborani ishlating.
steps.prompt: Describe a time when something unexpected happened. Say what happened, when and where it happened, and how you felt.
steps.example: I'd like to talk about the day I unexpectedly met my favourite writer. It happened last spring, when I was visiting a book fair in Tashkent with my sister. We were looking at some old novels when, all of a sudden, I heard a familiar voice. It turned out that the author of my favourite book was signing copies at the next stand. I had read all of his novels, but I had never seen him in person. I was so thrilled that I could hardly speak. Looking back, that short conversation was a turning point, because it inspired me to start writing my own stories.
